news.title: UNI is building stronger communities through the Heartland Economic Development Course
news.summary_en: The Midwest is no stranger to tornadoes and floods. We’re familiar with small, main street shops closing down. And we wonder why some commute over an hour to work every day. Maybe we ask ourselves, “Who’s job is it to help communities in need? How can we bring jobs to our city?
